name: Honey Balsamic Chicken with Crispy Broccoli & Potatoes
assumptions: Recipe explicitly states 2 Servings at top of instructions.
Total active and passive time (preheat, roast 20-25 min, pan-cook chicken 10-12 min, simmer glaze 2-3 min, prep) conservatively sums to 45 minutes.
Chicken breast, chicken stock, and butter are animal-derived and dairy, ruling out Vegetarian/Vegan/Pescatarian.
No barley/rye/wheat/oats listed so Gluten-free is true; Wheat is false.
Butter confirms Milk allergen true; no other allergens explicitly listed so most are null.
Balsamic vinegar, honey, and stock concentrate have unspecified/ambiguous measurements in original but are treated conservatively as listed.
instructions:
2 Servings

1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry all produce. Cut potatoes into 1/2-inch-thick wedges. Toss on one side of a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. (For 4 servings, spread potatoes out across entire sheet.) Roast on top rack for 5 minutes (we'll add the broccoli then). 

2. Meanwhile, cut broccoli florets into bite-size pieces, if necessary. Peel and finely chop garlic. In a small microwave-safe bowl, combine 1 TBSP olive oil (2 TBSP for 4 servings) and half the garlic. Microwave until garlic sizzles, 30 seconds. 

3. Once potatoes have roasted 5 minutes, remove sheet from oven and add broccoli to empty side; carefully toss with garlic oil, salt, and pepper. (For 4 servings, add broccoli to a second sheet.) Continue roasting until potatoes and broccoli are browned and crispy, 15-20 minutes more. 

4. While veggies roast, pat chicken dry with paper towels; season all over with salt and pepper. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 5-6 minutes per side. (If chicken browns too quickly, reduce heat to medium.) Turn off heat; set chicken aside to rest. Wash out pan. 

5. Heat pan used for chicken over medium-high heat. Add a drizzle of oil and remaining garlic; cook until fragrant, 30 seconds. Stir in vinegar, honey, stock concentrate, and 1/4 cup water (1/3 cup for 4 servings). Simmer until thick and glossy, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4). Season with salt and pepper. 

6. Return chicken to pan and turn to coat in glaze. Divide chicken, broccoli, and potatoes between plates. Spoon any remaining glaze over chicken and serve.

ingredients.name: Potatoes
ingredients.assumptions: 5 medium russet potatoes (about 100g each) used as wedges, raw weight before roasting

ingredients.name: Broccoli
ingredients.assumptions: 1 large head of broccoli (florets and stem), raw weight cut into bite-size pieces

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.assumptions: 2 average garlic cloves (3g each), raw and finely chopped

ingredients.name: Chicken Breast
ingredients.assumptions: 2 medium boneless skinless chicken breasts (200g each), raw weight before cooking

ingredients.name: Balsamic Vinegar
ingredients.assumptions: Balsamic vinegar amount estimated from glaze instructions (about 2 tbsp for 2 servings); typical recipe usage for honey balsamic glaze

ingredients.name: Honey
ingredients.assumptions: Honey amount estimated from glaze instructions (about 2 tbsp for 2 servings); typical recipe usage for honey balsamic glaze

ingredients.name: Chicken Stock
ingredients.assumptions: Chicken stock concentrate (bouillon) amount estimated as 1 tbsp or 1 packet equivalent for 2 servings, dissolved in water per instructions

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbsp butter as listed, used to finish the glaze

ingredients.name: Vegetable Oil
ingredients.assumptions: Vegetable oil (1 tbsp) for pan-frying chicken and aromatics; typical household measure for 'a drizzle' across steps

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: Olive oil (1 tbsp) for garlic oil and initial potato toss; matches listed measurement and 'drizzle' usage in instructions
